sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, sitting 1st with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach come into the fixture off the back of a loss but remain in strong form overall, having won 4 of their last 5 games. Alsager are struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches and a run of five losses in their last six outings, making them vulnerable opponents.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host bottom-dwellers Widnes Town on Saturday, looking to close the two-point gap on Sandbach after a recent loss. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall, who sit fifth and are in good form after a recent win. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and unbeaten in their last four, host Wednesfield Community at home before facing Sandbach away on Wednesday 7 October. Bilston Town (6th) host Foley Meir (13th) as high-fliers meet mid-table strugglers. Market Drayton Town (10th, winless in recent outings) are away at New Mills (8th), while Crewe entertain Allscott Heath and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in fixtures between teams in the lower half. Shawbury United, enduring a six-game losing run, face Barnton at home. Brereton Social (14th, recently defeated) visit Widnes on Saturday before hosting Wednesfield on Wednesday evening.
